snapshot.vintage: Downloaded data vintage, not a real-time vintage reconstruction

protocol.target: Transition from USREC=0 to USREC=1 in the next 12 calendar months, excluding the selected month
protocol.embargo: Each training label window ends strictly before the January refit date
protocol.vintageLimitation: Retrospective downloaded vintage; revised yields and final recession chronology do not reproduce information or announcements available in real time. Monthly yields are treated as available at month end.
protocol.spreadDefinition: GS10 minus TB3MS, percentage points; the underlying series use investment and discount quoted bases respectively.
